classification: exploratory finite-shear water-air interface-instability diagnostic; not a Dash-8 reproduction or E1-E3 acceptance case
solver: OpenCFD OpenFOAM v2512 interIsoFoam, pinned image opencfd/openfoam-default:2512
coordinate_frame: periodic Cartesian domain; x is streamwise, y spanwise, z cross-shear

seeded_mode.phase: eta=A*sin(2*pi*x/Lx); lower and upper water-film interfaces move in phase and the seed is invariant in y

initial_phase.alpha_water_initialization: subcell quadrature of the displaced slab; water alpha in [0,1]

base_velocity.profile: two periodic tanh transitions at the water-film interfaces; same shape on both interfaces

boundary_conditions: cyclic in x, y, and z; the periodic z-domain has two interfaces and no open boundaries
turbulence_treatment: laminar molecular baseline plus the same added kinematic-viscosity increment in each phase as a damping surrogate; effective dynamic viscosity remains phase-density weighted, and this is not a RANS or LES closure
case_variants: uniform 25 m/s advection control, molecular viscosities
50 m/s finite-thickness air-water shear, molecular viscosities
same shear with nu_add=0.01 m2/s in both phases as a damping surrogate
diagnostics: lower- and upper-interface complex Fourier modes, their relative phase, and symmetric/antisymmetric combinations
Fourier spectra of each interface mode
finite-time log-amplitude slope after the initial transient
plane-averaged velocity jump and tanh shear-thickness evolution around both interfaces
water volume, relative phase-volume drift, alpha bounds
periodic central-difference divergence and solver continuity residuals
time step, runtime, mesh size, and container resource samples
interpretation: The inviscid vortex-sheet growth rate is recorded only as an approximate reference. No finite-thickness eigenvalue or Dash-8 validation claim is made.

parameter_provenance.50 m/s air-relative speed: plan-scale Dash-8 crossflow input from the E2 description; used in an idealized periodic shear box, not a reproduction of that case
parameter_provenance.domain dimensions and water-film thickne: assumed diagnostic geometry selected to fit periodic wavelengths and separated interfaces
parameter_provenance.seed amplitude and phase: assumed deterministic Fourier perturbation, prescribed by this case
parameter_provenance.tanh shear thickness: assumed diagnostic input, not measured from a Dash-8 sheet
parameter_provenance.added kinematic viscosity: assumed controlled damping surrogate, not a calibrated turbulence closure
parameter_provenance.zero surface tension and gravity: deliberate stability-diagnostic simplifications, not claims about the aircraft drop

v2_experiment.classification: new exploratory V2 eigenmode-seeded finite-shear diagnostic; V1 inputs and runs above are retained verbatim
v2_experiment.coordinate_frame: periodic Cartesian box; x streamwise, y spanwise, z across the two interfaces
v2_experiment.base_velocity_m_s: U(z)=50-25*tanh((z-0.03)/delta)+25*tanh((z-0.09)/delta), periodic in z; 50 m/s air, 0 m/s water

seeded_mode.alpha_interface_phase: Use the finite-thickness eigenpair's two complex interface displacements, normalized so max(abs(eta_lower),abs(eta_upper)) is 0.05 mm
seeded_mode.velocity_phase: Initialize Re(u_hat(z)*exp(i*k*x)) and Re(w_hat(z)*exp(i*k*x)) from the same inviscid eigenpair; temporal convention exp(i*k*x+sigma*t)

v2_experiment.linear_reference: paired-interface, finite-thickness, variable-density inviscid eigenpair; reference and residual/hash recorded with each run; vortex-sheet rate remains diagnostic only
case_variants: molecular-shear eigenmode baseline on both meshes
zero-shear uniform-advection control with the identical 0.05 mm geometric wave, no eigenmode velocity perturbation
coarse-mesh shear run with nu_add=1.0e-4 m2/s in each phase as a controlled damping surrogate (not RANS/LES)
diagnostics: alpha-volume Fourier mode for each interface and symmetric/antisymmetric combinations
alpha=.5 contour after cell-to-point interpolation, fixed lower/upper branches and subcell edge interpolation
native surfaceScalarField phi and fieldFunctionObjects div result divPhi; volume-weighted signed/absolute distributions
water volume/mass, alpha bounds, continuity residuals, time-step stability, resource use
transient and declared-window exponential growth rates against the finite-thickness eigenvalue
v2_experiment.boundary_conditions: cyclic x,y,z; one streamwise wave per domain; two periodic interfaces; no physical/open boundary flux
v2_experiment.turbulence_treatment: laminar molecular baseline; an equal kinematic-viscosity increment in both phases is reported only as a damping surrogate, not as a RANS/LES closure
v2_experiment.interpretation: Isolated shear-mechanism diagnostic only. No Dash-8 geometry, aircraft-boundary interaction, or Dash-8 validation claim.

parameter_provenance.density and molecular viscosity: assumed nominal liquid water and air properties
parameter_provenance.finite shear thickness and film geometry: declared diagnostic assumptions, not measured from a Dash-8 sheet
parameter_provenance.0.05 mm mode amplitude: assumed linear-regime displacement chosen after the inviscid reference indicated rapid amplification
parameter_provenance.added viscosity increment: assumed controlled numerical/physical damping surrogate; not a turbulence calibration
